DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce.description: Soft-deletes a PIR. The PIR will no longer count against quota.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce.summary: Delete an account interest for PIR Option 2
DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce.description: Deletes a structured account interest so later Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations no longer include it.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: List priority intelligence requirements for an account
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Lists free-form Priority Intelligence Requirements for the account. Results are scoped to the authenticated account.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Get a priority intelligence requirement by ID
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Returns a single free-form Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: List a priority intelligence requirement's matched events
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Returns the events matched by the PIR's query, newest match first. Each item has the Event List event fields plus the match fields. Only datasets the account can read now are included, and deleted events are left out, so a page can hold fewer items than `per_page` while `result_info.cursor` is still set. `backfill` matches came from the 30 days before the PIR was activated or its query changed and are never notified. `delivered` matches were included in a digest that the notification service accepted; who receives it depends on the account's notification policies for the PIR. Requires the Threat Events entitlement.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `result_info.cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the newest matches.

schema.description: `result_info.cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the newest matches.

parameters.name: triage_state
parameters.description: Only matches in this triage state.

schema.description: Only matches in this triage state.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Get PIR constants (methods, dimensions, and TLP values)
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Requirements is the existing free-form PIR method. Interests is the experimental structured-interest method, evaluated independently from requirements.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: List account interests for PIR Option 2
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Lists structured account interests for Priority Intelligence Option 2. Filter by enabled state and paginate results.
Returns a previously completed account-interest backtest by ID. The backtest must belong to this account.
Returns a previously completed live account-interest evaluation by ID. The evaluation must belong to this account.

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.summary: Triage a priority intelligence requirement's matched events
PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.description: Sets `triage_state` (`new`, `relevant`, or `not_relevant`) on up to 100 matches. Matches that do not exist, or are in datasets the account can no longer read, are returned in `not_found`. Setting `new` clears `triaged_at` and `triaged_by`. Requires the Threat Events entitlement.

matches.description: Up to 100 matches to set the triage state on.

200.description: The matches that were updated and those not found

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.summary: Update an account interest for PIR Option 2
PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.description: Updates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Changing the value re-resolves the interest against the current catalog.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Creates a new PIR for the account. The cfone.priority_intelligence_requirement_limit entitlement sets how many PIRs can be active; drafts do not count, but the account can hold at most five times that many PIRs in total. An active PIR requires a query.

dataset_scope.description: `default`: every event dataset the account can read: Cloudforce One intelligence, datasets shared with the account, and the account's own datasets, such as Threat Signals. `datasets`: explicit dataset IDs. Analytics datasets are not matched. An active PIR can cover at most 50 datasets. Access is rechecked whenever the PIR is matched.

digest_interval_hours.description: Hours between digests: 6, 12, or 24. Used only when `notification_mode` is `digest`.

notification_mode.description: `none` or `digest`. Notifications are opt-in. `immediate` is reserved and currently rejected.

branches.description: Event List `searchBranches`: filters within a branch are ANDed, branches are ORed.

version.description: Ignored. Accepted so a PIR read from the API can be sent back unchanged.

status.description: `draft`: not monitored. `active`: monitored, unless `pause_reason` is set. Setting `active` on a PIR with a `pause_reason` resumes it. Moving a PIR back to `draft` and activating it again starts matching afresh with a 30-day backfill.

400.description: Invalid PIR, such as an active PIR without a query

403.description: Account not entitled to create PIRs

429.description: Active PIR quota or total PIR limit exceeded

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Generate event filters from a PIR
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Translates a natural-language Priority Intelligence Requirement into Threat Events `searchBranches` with Workers AI. Terms that cannot be expressed as event filters are returned in `unresolved_terms`. Nothing is stored or executed.

requirement.example: Track North Korean or Russian actors phishing banks in the United States

custom_feed_count.description: The current count of custom feeds for the account.

custom_feed_limit.description: The custom feed limit for the account.

custom_feed_count.description: The current count of custom feeds for the account.

custom_feed_limit.description: The custom feed limit for the account.

branches.description: Event List `searchBranches`: filters within a branch are ANDed, branches are ORed. Empty when coverage is `none`.

coverage.description: `full`: every term resolved. `partial`: some terms are unresolved. `none`: no filter could be generated.

intent.description: Structured intent extracted from the requirement, before catalog resolution.

model.description: Workers AI model used for intent extraction.

unresolved_terms.description: Requirement terms that could not be expressed as event filters.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Create an account interest for PIR Option 2
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Creates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Interests are evaluated independently from free-form PIR requirements.
Uses bounded full-span top-N candidates and daily event-date buckets. Results are conservative rather than an exact historical replay.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Evaluate recent event-dated changes for account interests
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Compares the trailing event-date window with the preceding window. Results are precision-gated to enabled account interests. Late ingestion can cause an older event to appear in a later evaluation, so results describe changes in event-dated intelligence rather than exact adversary-activity timing.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Get PIR quota for an account
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Returns the account's PIR quota. `quota` and `remaining` count active PIRs against the entitlement limit; moving a PIR to draft or deleting it frees its slot. `total_quota` and `total_remaining` count every PIR, drafts included, against five times the limit. Anniversary dates are informational.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Updates a Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account. Changing the query increments its version; editing the requirement without saving a query marks the query stale. Activating a draft needs a free slot in the active PIR quota; setting `active` on a PIR the matcher paused resumes it without one.

confirm_query.description: Write-only. `true` confirms the query still fits the requirement, clearing `query_stale` without changing the query or its version. Requires a query.

dataset_scope.description: `default`: every event dataset the account can read: Cloudforce One intelligence, datasets shared with the account, and the account's own datasets, such as Threat Signals. `datasets`: explicit dataset IDs. Analytics datasets are not matched. An active PIR can cover at most 50 datasets. Access is rechecked whenever the PIR is matched.

digest_interval_hours.description: Hours between digests: 6, 12, or 24. Used only when `notification_mode` is `digest`.

notification_mode.description: `none` or `digest`. Notifications are opt-in. `immediate` is reserved and currently rejected.
